_meta.status: DEMO KNOWLEDGE BASE - not clinically reviewed
_meta.notice: Everyday wording for medical terms in patient-facing summaries. 'plain' replaces the term in a sentence (the term is kept once in brackets); 'explain' is one sentence for 'Words you might see'. The meanings follow standard patient-information sources; the wording is the app's and must be reviewed by a clinician before any real use. Aliases are matched case-insensitively and abbreviations case-sensitively, as whole words.

sources.MEDLINEPLUS: MedlinePlus (U.S. National Library of Medicine), medlineplus.gov: lab test and health topic pages.
sources.NHS: NHS Health A to Z, nhs.uk.
sources.RX: Common prescription abbreviations as written on prescriptions.
